subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: an hour without supervision

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: key possession
fact: The key once hung around Kalan Strongbranch's neck and was later handed to Daz.
source_quote: It had hung around Kalan Strongbranch's neck once. I... handed it to Daz

subject: sapphire summoning token
fact: The stolen sapphire is a retrieval token for a summoning spell that binds to an item not in any living person's possession.
source_quote: The sapphire isn't decoration: it's the retrieval token... a dead person possesses nothing

subject: poison activation
fact: The poison turns black only upon contact with a living being's saliva, not when exposed to air or inert objects.
source_quote: When I mixed with his saliva, it turned black... The stuff only wakes up when a living thing touches it

subject: Oak Tree Apothecary
fact: The Oak Tree Apothecary is located between the Sea Warden's Tower and the House of Mechanus, a treehouse grown into the roots of an evergreen oak.
source_quote: The Oak Tree Apothecary, he said, between the Sea Warden's Tower and the House of Mechanus, a treehouse grown into the roots of an evergreen oak

subject: key retrieval magic
fact: The summoning spell requires the sapphire to be the same token used for both storage and recall — a backup against key theft.
source_quote: The sapphire is actually used to sort of be able to retrieve the key... a backup, in other words, against theft of the original

subject: poison vial
fact: The poison, in its inactive state, appears as a clear liquid in a vial, not as a dark substance.
source_quote: A vial of some sort of clear

subject: book tampering timeline
fact: The book was placed under the evergreen tree at 11am on Deadwinter's Eve, wrapped, and later picked up by Janussi at dinner — unchanged in appearance.
source_quote: He'd dropped the book under the evergreen tree... around 11am on Deadwinter's Eve... wrapped

subject: dining room
fact: The dining room is one of the rooms left unwatched during the investigation, where a poisoner would logically operate.
source_quote: The dining room, for one. Where the meals were served, and where, if you were a poisoner, you'd have wanted to be.

subject: Fembris departure
fact: Fembris left his post as minder to attend Grygum's theological debate, creating an hour of unsupervised access to the library.
source_quote: Fembris asked to leave... to attend a debate... his departure handed us an hour without supervision

subject: locket contents
fact: The locket taken from the murdered man likely contained the key, which was separate from the sapphire.
source_quote: Some locket from around the dude's neck was taken. We assume that inside that locket was the key.

subject: Zalthir's key inspection
fact: Zalthir's inspection of the key revealed no magical binding to the summoning spell — the key was clean and unrelated to the sapphire's magic.
source_quote: The answer was no. The key was clean. Not linked to that spell, not created by it, carrying no quiet enchantment

subject: Daral's confession
fact: Daral admitted to drunken barroom talk about dragonborn, fearing it might be used to frame him, and believed Zalthir recorded everything.
source_quote: he'd worked out someone wanted him to take the fall... nobody would mention to Zalthir what he'd said about dragonborn. Drunk, barroom talk... Zalthir said, in a voice that recorded everything

subject: Strongbranch's caution
fact: Strongbranch handed over his key because he feared its magical connection to the summoning spell, and understood that a dead man cannot possess anything.
source_quote: Strongbranch handed his off rather than wear it. Paranoid, maybe... you don't survive long arguing with a dead man's caution

subject: Oval Theater
fact: The Oval Theater is where Grygum's theological debate is held, attended by half the Avowed and Bookwyrm herself.
source_quote: a disputation in the Oval Theater on his new theology, with half the avowed already in attendance and Bookwyrm herself unable to politically afford to miss it
